purpose.domain_detail: IBM CICSPlex SM (CPSM) infrastructure utility for dynamically detecting the CICSplex name at runtime, avoiding hardcoded CICSplex names in application source code
purpose.summary: SM540API is an IBM CICS online program that uses the CICSPlex SM API to dynamically derive the CICSplex name of the current environment. It queries CMASPLEX and CICSRGN resource tables via CPSM threads to obtain the CICSplex name, storing it in WS-SAVED-CICSPLEXNAME, eliminating the need to hardcode CICSplex names when moving code between test and production environments.
